Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the generational relationships after reviewing the 3rd Earl’s page, incorrectly inferring that Arthur Acheson, 1st Earl of Gosford was the 4th Earl’s paternal grandfather. The paternal grandfather is the father’s father (i.e., the 2nd Earl), not the grandfather of the father’s father. This reflects a lineage logic error and a premature conclusion that contradicted the established father–son chain.
